visualDiagnosis.materials: Dark metallic roles receive insufficient diffuse response: the roof, clerestory, glazing, machinery, and heat cues merge with the masonry and disappear at thumbnail scale.
visualDiagnosis.portal: The structural frame is darker than the nominal void, inverting the intended jamb-header-recess depth read even though the semantic frame support survives.
visualDiagnosis.lighting: The deterministic key, fill, world, and high-contrast look leave the occupied median at 0.0555 and p95 at 0.2081; this is an illumination and material-response failure, not an occupancy or camera-scale failure.
visualDiagnosis.camera: The frozen camera is not a repair lever: the 514-pixel source occupied width already resolves to approximately 64.25 pixels at literal 192 scale.
